item.title: Iran live updates: US is 'very close' to deal with Iran, Trump says
item.summary: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: WATCH: Sec. Hegseth warns Iranian leadership to ‘choose wisely’ as U.S. seeks deal
item.summary: Secretary Pete Hegseth issued a new warning to the Iranian regime at a Pentagon press briefing, telling them to "choose wisely" and to reach an agreement with the U.S. to permanently end the war.

item.title: WATCH: Spring allergies may worsen as warmer weather arrives
item.summary: Dr. Leonard Bielory, allergist and immunologist, explains what is driving seasonal allergies and how people can best manage symptoms.

item.title: WATCH: Israel and Lebanon agree to 10-day ceasefire, President Trump says
item.summary: Israel and Lebanon have agreed to a 10-day ceasefire beginning April 16, President Trump announced in a post on social media.

item.title: WATCH: What happens if you miss the tax deadline and what is the penalty?
item.summary: It’s less than 24 hours until Tax Day. David Perez, CEO of Tax Maverick, enrolled agent and best-selling author, answers some of the most trending tax-related questions.

item.title: WATCH: Struggling delivery robots get a boost from helpful humans in Finland
item.summary: A couple of food delivery robots got an assist from some helpful humans who spotted them struggling to get over a curb in Turku, Finland.

item.title: ICE agent charged with 2 counts of felony assault in Minneapolis
item.summary: An ICE agent has been charged with two counts of second degree assault which occurred in February, according to the Hennepin County Attorney’s office in Minneapolis.

item.title: Minibus taxi catches fire in Zimbabwe, killing several people
item.summary: Police in Zimbabwe say that several people were killed when a minibus taxi they were traveling in caught fire

item.title: WATCH: David Muir shares San Francisco Giants' surprise for fan who dropped phone at game
item.summary: While taking photos of her son during a San Francisco Giants game, a woman’s phone fell onto the field. It was recovered by the grounds crew – along with a cool surprise from the team.
